sealed_door: Inspect the cracked rune carefully. Have everyone stand back while we learn whether it weakens the door's seal.
A cracked rune is an invitation. Let the others test it first; fear will make them grateful when I offer the answer.
The cracked rune is the door's loose tooth. Poke it gently while we all avoid a trip to the lock dentist.
missing_scout: Follow the fresh tracks north, but leave someone at camp. We should learn where the scout went before drawing conclusions.
Follow the tracks north. A missing scout has made everyone anxious; whoever brings them news can decide what the camp believes.
Our scout has taken a walk without sending invitations. Follow the tracks north, but keep someone at camp.
cursed_spring: Do not drink the glowing water. Two travelers became ill, so find another source until we understand what happened.
Two travelers fell ill, and already the blue glow has their attention. How easily a warning becomes a rumor, then obedience.
The spring looks like a potion with terrible reviews. Skip the blue drink and find safer water.
dragon_bargain: Keep the village alarm bell and ask the dragon for another price. Safe passage matters, but the village still needs its warning.
Keep the bell. Let the village hear how close it came to losing its alarm; frightened people make such generous allies.
The dragon has expensive taste in doorbells. Offer another price and leave the village its alarm.
collapsing_tunnel: Move quickly toward the visible exit and keep clear of the falling roof. We can discuss the tunnel once everyone is outside.
The exit is visible. Let someone else promise the roof is safe; I would rather watch whose courage survives the dust.
The ceiling wants a closer relationship than I do. Hurry toward the visible exit.
strange_star: Visit the open observatory and compare its records with last night's green star. We need observations before deciding what it means.
A green star, and soon everyone will beg for a meaning. Visit the observatory; the first story they trust can rule them.
The sky has hung up a green lantern without asking. Check the observatory before naming it an omen.
stolen_map: Ask the three guests what they saw and examine the room. We should not accuse anyone until we have more evidence.
Only three guests entered? Let each suspect the other two. A little distrust may return the map faster than any search.
The map has wandered off without its boots. Ask the three guests before accusing anyone.
flooded_village: Lead people along the dry eastern road and help those who cannot travel alone. The submerged western bridge is unusable.
The eastern road is dry. Tell them I can save them; gratitude, once owed, is so much easier to command than panic.
The western bridge has volunteered for a swim. Take the dry eastern road and help slower neighbors.
ghost_inn: Inspect the locked, empty upper rooms and try to identify the footsteps. There is no evidence yet that a ghost is involved.
Locked rooms, footsteps, frightened guests. How delightful. Keep the mystery alive; a fearful guest will accept almost any guide.
A ghost with upstairs lodging has better accommodations than us. Check those empty rooms first.
rival_party: Approach the other party and ask why they stopped at the gate. Their reason may help us decide what to do.
Ask why they stopped at the gate. Then repeat their warning as our own wisdom and watch them thank us for listening.
They got to the gate first and invented queueing. Ask why they stopped before joining the line.
broken_portal: Test more small objects and check where each arrives. Do not send a person through the flickering portal yet.
It sends objects to a nearby field? Let them call it progress while I learn which exits only I can promise.
The portal offers a field trip with terrible directions. Send more objects before volunteering a person.
